ขี้ฝุ่น / ขี้ผึ้ง

rule: ขี้ runs one clean chain and 18 of 27 sort along it. Sense 2 is the substance itself (ขี้หมา, ขี้เทา the meconium, and โยนขี้, which throws it). Sense 3 is what cakes on a BODY — ขี้มือ, ขี้ตีน, ขี้เกลือ, ขี้เล็บ, and ขี้เรื้อน the crusting mange. Sense 4 is anything unwanted once the body is out of the picture: a rag (ขี้ริ้ว), a servant spoken of with contempt (ขี้ข้า, ขี้เค้า), and the green that grows where it is not wanted (ขี้ตะไคร่, ขี้แดด). Sense 5 is narrower than 4 and takes only residue OF a named thing — ash out of fire (ขี้เถ้า and its dead spelling ขี้เท่า), wax out of a hive (ขี้ผึ้ง), slag out of iron (ขี้เหล็ก, which then names the tree), and the general leavings ขี้ผง. NINE WORDS DO NOT FILE and are left open on purpose: see the log.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 95-99, and a head that would not file
notes.h3: ขี้ — 18 of 27 file, and the other 9 CANNOT
notes.text:
This is not an ingest bug. The source dictionary itself prints exactly five
glosses for ขี้ and none of them reaches a disposition, while POS-tagging four of
these nine **คำคุณศัพท์** and giving every one of them the etymology `ขี้ + X`.
The source documents the sense in the daughter entries and omits it from the head.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 95-99, and a head that would not file
notes.h3: ขี้ — 18 of 27 file, and the other 9 CANNOT
notes.text:
**คู่ divides by what the two are TO EACH OTHER.** 2 is the working pair, two that
belong together and are better for it (คู่ซี้, คู่หู, คู่ใจ, คู่ขา, the two monks
who chant an ordination, mixed doubles, and คู่มือ the manual that stays at your
hand). 3 narrows to marriage and takes seven, including the two that reach into a
former life, คู่บุญ and เนื้อคู่. 5 is the pair held APART — คู่กรณี, คู่พิพาท,
คู่แข่ง, คู่กัด, คู่อาฆาต — and it takes **คู่มิตร** too, which is friendly but is
still a fixed relation between two charts, the counterpart of คู่ศัตรู.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 95-99, and a head that would not file
notes.h3: ขี้ — 18 of 27 file, and the other 9 CANNOT
notes.text:
**บังคู่ does not file.** A small stool nailed up from THREE pieces of wood: not a
pair, not an even number, not a spouse, not a counterpart. No etymology given;
บัง alone is a Khmer loan (*bang*, to screen) or Malay *abang*, and neither reads
with คู่ to make a stool. Probably regional and borrowed whole, but there is
nothing to tag it false-split ON, so it is left open with the reasoning attached.
